name: DaSiWa MiniMax H3: Hybrid v3 (int8, full steps)
author: Darksidewalker
note: One file that does text, first/last frame and references: MiniMax's fl2va and ref2va merged, pruned, stored in int8 ConvRot (needs a recent ComfyUI). Made for the full 20 to 30 steps with res_multistep; the form's defaults already are that. MiniMax's own text encoder and VAEs beside it.
